scores.note: All use 'enfranchise' correctly with paragraph ideas only. 2 'enfranchise them to have a say' is an awkward, redundant construction. 3 compresses the Austria point into a causal 'leads to'. 4 is near-tautological (enfranchise -> can vote). 1 and 5 reuse the same jobs/taxes/driving list.
